A '''government warehouse''' was located in the [[Sundari warehouse district/Legends|warehouse district]] of the [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorian]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Sundari/Legends|Sundari]] on [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]]. The warehouse was used by the New [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]]' [[Prime Minister/Legends|Prime Minister]], [[Almec/Legends|Almec]], to store black market goods.
